dct_description_sm: Excel file containing all raw data for the manuscript "The effects of pulse exposures to road salt at various stages of early development in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss)" including embryo survival, egg weight and ion composition for trout embryos exposure to multiple environmentally relevant 24h pulses of road salt. The first worksheet is a README with descriptions of the contents of the file
